stress_report.json.row_granularity: one scenario object containing one instrument result per metadata instrument, including quantity_t1 equal to zero
deterministic_ordering: each instruments array by instrument_name ascending
object keys written in lexicographic order

top_level_field_types.base_valuation_timestamp_utc: UTC timestamp string equal to config benchmark_t1_utc

scenario_field_types.spot_shock_pct: finite JSON number matching the input
scenario_field_types.vol_shock_abs: finite JSON number matching the input
scenario_field_types.instruments: array containing exactly one object per metadata instrument

instrument_field_types.contract_multiplier: finite JSON number greater than zero
instrument_field_types.stressed_spot_usd: finite JSON number greater than zero
instrument_field_types.stressed_iv_decimal: finite JSON number greater than zero before expiry

validation_report.json.row_granularity: one run-level report with zero or more validation records
deterministic_ordering: warnings sorted by code, file, row_key, field
errors sorted by code, file, row_key, field, message
object keys written in lexicographic order

record_semantics.file: string input filename or null for a cross-file/run-level condition
record_semantics.row_key: string logical primary key value or null; instrument_name for instrument rows and scenario_id for scenarios
record_semantics.field: string field name or null for a row/file/cross-field condition
record_semantics.message: deterministic human-readable explanation without environment-specific paths

validation_report.json.warning_message_contract: message is deterministic, non-empty, and free of environment-specific paths; it is not compared verbatim by the grader

warning_rules.cardinality: exactly one record per input file whose physical row/array order differs from its input_schema canonical_sort_key
warning_rules.message_requirement: deterministic, non-empty, and free of environment-specific paths; not compared verbatim by the grader

warning_rules.cardinality: exactly one record per affected market_t0 instrument, regardless of the number of excess exact copies
warning_rules.message_requirement: deterministic, non-empty, and free of environment-specific paths; not compared verbatim by the grader

warning_rules.cardinality: exactly one record per instrument and missing/null optional quote field among source_bid_price_coin, source_ask_price_coin, source_mark_price_coin, source_mark_iv_pct
warning_rules.field: the missing optional quote field name
warning_rules.message_requirement: deterministic, non-empty, and free of environment-specific paths; not compared verbatim by the grader

warning_rules.cardinality: exactly one record per instrument whose finite source_bid_price_coin equals zero
warning_rules.message_requirement: deterministic, non-empty, and free of environment-specific paths; not compared verbatim by the grader

warning_rules.cardinality: exactly one record per instrument whose finite bid is greater than its finite ask
warning_rules.message_requirement: deterministic, non-empty, and free of environment-specific paths; not compared verbatim by the grader

warning_rules.cardinality: only when the optional numeric column physical type matches input_schema: exactly one record per instrument and present NaN, +Infinity, -Infinity, or explicitly documented semantically invalid numeric value; missing/null quote fields use OPTIONAL_QUOTE_MISSING instead
warning_rules.field: the ignored optional source field name
warning_rules.message_requirement: deterministic, non-empty, and free of environment-specific paths; not compared verbatim by the grader

validation_report.json.error_record_contract: Errors use the same five-field record shape and must be deterministic for one implementation. When multiple fatal defects coexist, detection order and cascading record count are not cross-implementation output requirements; future evaluation may require only documented status/exit/output behavior and relevant public error categories, never an undisclosed message or record sequence.
